data.title: Business Development Representative (Remote, Full-Time)
data.description:
About Smart Working At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.   Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally. Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.   About the Role As a Business Development Representative, you will be a key part of the sales team, responsible for generating a strong pipeline through focused outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will research and engage potential customers, qualify opportunities, and ensure promising leads are smoothly passed across for further development. This is a fast-paced, high-activity role centred around personalised outreach, pipeline creation, and accurate CRM management. You will work alongside the wider sales team to develop account strategies and messaging, test and improve outbound approaches, and contribute to business growth through consistent execution and strong commercial judgement.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/business-development-representative-remote-full-time-smart-working

data.title: SEO Lead
data.description:
AutoLeap is looking for an enthusiastic and energetic SEO Lead to join our Marketing team. As an SEO Lead at AutoLeap, you will be responsible for helping the Marketing team in executing optimization techniques for its customers. The ideal candidate for this role will have a deep passion for digital marketing, superior customer experience and entrepreneurship. About AutoLeap AutoLeap is the market-leading shop management SaaS provider in the underserved auto repair industry. The Shop Management System (SMS) provides an all-in-one, cloud-based auto repair management software that helps after-market auto shop owners focused on general repair to better understand, manage and grow their business—from scheduling appointments to managing technicians and generating invoices to help save time and money. In 2023, we announced our $30M Series B, led by Advanced Venture Partners (AVP), with continued participation from Bain Capital Ventures and Threshold Ventures. And we aren’t slowing down! Our mission is to change the auto repair industry one shop at a time, helping shop owners get home to their families earlier and helping them build long-lasting healthy businesses to pass on to future generations. We will be the de facto choice for all shop owners looking to grow and improve their businesses with your help! We take pride in creating an exceptional workplace and experience—here’s how that’s been recognized: 🏆Certified Great Place to Work since 2021 🏆Fortune’s 2024 Best Workplaces in Technology (Small & Medium Businesses) 🏆Numerous G2 Awards (some include: Momentum Leader, Best Relationship, Leader) 🏆One of the Best SMB Companies in North America by SMB Tech 50 As an SEO Lead, you will: - Coordinate SEO efforts and website optimization for repair shops in North America - Perform keyword research to guide on-page and off-page optimization. - Implement and manage organic strategies for businesses including technical SEO, content creation and link-building campaigns. - Review issues on websites and recommend fixes, - Use analytical tools to monitor, analyze and improve search performance. - Develop optimization strategies that increase search engine results rankings for various websites. - Keep abreast of SEO and integrated marketing trends - And so much more! To be successful in this role, you will need: - 4-5 years of professional experience in SEO - Strong SEO expertise across SaaS/B2B websites, including keyword research, search intent, content strategy, site architecture, and internal linking. - Deep knowledge of technical SEO, website optimization, crawling, indexing, and ranking. - Proven track record of ranking competitive keywords in the Top 3. - Experience with AI SEO, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming frog. - Strong analytical, communication, and ownership skills with a focus on business impact. If this sounds like something you’ll be great at, apply away! Location/Time Zone: Candidates must be able to consistently work within Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/seo-lead-autoleap

data.title: Informatica Solution Architect - MDM and Enterprise Integration
data.description:
Do you want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? We are growing and are looking for people to join our team. You'll be part of an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment of 300.000 employees. Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready? Job Overview: Lead discovery, current-state assessment and target-state solution architecture across Informatica, SAP ECC, MDM, PLM and the broader enterprise integration ecosystem. The role includes workshop leadership and close collaboration with Informatica as a strategic technology partner. Key Responsibilities Key responsibilities - Assess current MDM and integration landscape across Informatica, SAP ECC, future SAP S/4HANA, middleware, PLM and consuming systems. - Document applications, data flows, interfaces, ownership, dependencies, criticality and operational controls. - Assess batch, near-real-time, API-led, event-driven, file-based, message-based and point-to-point integration patterns. - Review master-data domain models, sources, match-and-merge, survivorship, trust, hierarchies, validations, workflows and distribution. - Assess product and material processes including hierarchies, units of measure, classifications, plant extensions, MRP attributes, statuses, recipes, formulations, BOMs and product structures. - Define target-state architecture, canonical data model and reusable services for creation, enrichment, approval, publication, extension, change and retirement. - Design controls for sequencing, idempotency, duplicate prevention, validation, acknowledgement, retry, replay and reconciliation. - Validate product capability, licensing assumptions, constraints, roadmap and implementation options with Informatica. - Ensure the design supports future SAP S/4HANA, cloud, analytics, AI and regional transformation initiatives. - Facilitate discovery and architecture workshops and develop a credible implementation roadmap. Requirements Required Qualifications Mandatory experience and skills - Senior Informatica MDM and enterprise integration architecture experience. - Strong SAP ECC integration and master-data knowledge. - Ability to assess complex landscapes and define pragmatic target-state solutions. - Hands-on understanding of API, event, batch, CDC, messaging and file-based patterns. - Strong consulting, workshop facilitation and client-facing communication skills. Preferred / advantageous experience - SAP S/4HANA, PLM and Consumer Packaged Goods experience. - Experience working directly with Informatica product or partner teams. - Previous discovery-to-RFP or architecture-led transformation experience. Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for individuals who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now. Benefits About Infosys Consulting Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey. Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our careers page. Within Europe, we are recognized as one of the UK’s top firms by the Financial Times and Forbes due to our client innovations, our cultural diversity and dedicated training and career paths. Infosys is on the Germany’s top employers list for 2023. Management Consulting Magazine named us on their list of Best Firms to Work for. Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row. We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal ambitions. Curious to learn more? We’d love to hear from you.... Apply today!

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/informatica-solution-architect-mdm-and-enterprise-integration-infosys-limited
